description: Fix O(n²) freeze in enrichDiffWithRenames by adding removed-count early exit, lowering size gates, and pre-filtering Levenshtein candidates

specs.description: Fuzzy rename pass is skipped when bKeys.length > 500 (exact rename/move still runs)
specs.given: A spec pair with 6000 keys total and 200 removed fields
specs.then: enrichDiffWithRenames completes in <1s; no Levenshtein is called; removed fields stay as 'removed' type

domain_conventions.FUZZY_SIZE_LIMIT: Upper bound on spec size for fuzzy matching. Exact rename/move (by serialized value) always runs regardless of size.

specs.description: Fuzzy rename pass is skipped when removed entries > 100 regardless of spec size
specs.given: A spec pair with 200 removed fields and 500 total keys
specs.then: enrichDiffWithRenames completes in <1s; no Levenshtein is called; removed fields stay as 'removed' type

domain_conventions.REMOVED_SIZE_SKIP: Early-exit threshold: if removed entries exceed this, fuzzy pass is skipped entirely. Most API diffs have <50 genuine renames.

specs.description: Fuzzy move pass is skipped when removed entries > 50 regardless of spec size
specs.given: A spec pair with 100 removed fields and 500 total keys
specs.then: enrichDiffWithRenames completes in <1s; no Levenshtein is called for move detection

domain_conventions.FUZZY_MOVE_SIZE_LIMIT: Even lower threshold for fuzzy move: moves are rarer than renames and the loop iterates all bKeys per removed entry. Set to 200 (same as FUZZY_SIZE_LIMIT).

specs.description: Pre-filtered candidate pool: only fbOnly keys that pass isRelated() are scored with Levenshtein
specs.given: A spec pair where exact rename misses and fuzzy rename is triggered (removed=20, total keys=400)
specs.then: matchScore is called at most 20 * 20 = 400 times (only on isRelated candidates), not 20 * 400 = 8000 times

domain_conventions.pre_filter: isRelated() is O(depth) string split — much cheaper than Levenshtein. Call isRelated() first; only call matchScore (which calls levenshtein) on candidates that pass.

specs.description: Exact rename detection (same serialized value, sibling or related path) always runs regardless of size limits
specs.given: A spec pair with 10,000 keys where 5 fields were renamed with identical values
specs.then: Those 5 fields are detected as 'renamed' type; exact rename uses fbOnlyByValue index (O(1) lookup per removed entry)

domain_conventions.exact_rename: Looks up removed value in fbOnlyByValue Map, then filters by isSibling/isRelated. No fuzzy loop needed for these cases.

specs.description: Empty spec pair returns empty results with no errors
specs.then: Returns empty array [] without errors; all size-limit checks pass trivially

specs.description: AbortSignal cancels an in-flight diff worker mid-computation
specs.given: A diff worker is running enrichDiffWithRenames on a large spec pair
specs.when: The caller's AbortSignal is aborted mid-run
specs.then: Worker posts {type:'cancelled', id} and terminates cleanly; no further messages are posted; worker is respawnable

domain_conventions.worker_cancellation: diff-worker.js receives AbortSignal via postMessage; checks it at loop boundaries; posts 'cancelled' message and returns early
